unstuck_said.text: Filed upstream issue #1 on github.com/Grant-Eakins/AgentToll suggesting ADD XNO (Nano) as a second x402 settlement scheme beside USDC on Base. Described in their own terms (canon ADD-not-switch): new line in accepts[] with scheme exact, network nano-mainnet, asset XNO. Cited live working example (nano-gpt.com x402 accepts nano-mainnet) and Nano x402 docs. Public GitHub issue, open research.
